lines.zh: 我贴着草走，脚不踩出声。
lines.en: I keep to the grass and walk without a sound.

lines.zh: 这坡太陡，我爬两步滑一步。
lines.en: The slope is steep; two steps up, one slide down.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边数你的东西。
lines.en: As I walk, I count your belongings.

lines.zh: 山里风大，我缩着肩赶路。
lines.en: Mountain wind is fierce; I trudge with hunched shoulders.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根枝条，先骂了一句。
lines.en: I snap a twig and curse at it first.

lines.zh: 往林子里走，那儿没人管。
lines.en: Into the woods, where nobody keeps order.

lines.zh: 我拖着棍子，地上划出白痕。
lines.en: I drag my club, scratching a white line.

lines.zh: 走慢点，前面可能有陷阱。
lines.en: Slow down; there may be traps ahead.

lines.zh: 我绕开大路，路上有卫兵。
lines.en: I avoid the road; guards walk there.

lines.zh: 草高过我的头，我跳着看路。
lines.en: Grass over my head, I hop to see the way.

lines.zh: 我踮脚走过碎石，怕惊动狗。
lines.en: I tiptoe over gravel to avoid waking dogs.

lines.zh: 两里地我走了半天，腿太短。
lines.en: Two miles takes me half a day; my legs are short.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，把口袋里的东西倒出来数。
lines.en: I squat and pour my pocket out to count it.

lines.zh: 没事干，我拿棍子敲石头玩。
lines.en: Nothing to do, so I tap stones with my club.

lines.zh: 我抠着指甲里的泥，抠了半天。
lines.en: I pick mud from under my nails for a long while.

lines.zh: 风把草吹得响，我以为是脚步。
lines.en: Wind rustles grass and I take it for footsteps.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，昨晚的萝卜还在。
lines.en: I burp; last night's turnip is still with me.

lines.zh: 我坐着想，为什么大家都躲我。
lines.en: I sit and wonder why everyone avoids me.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过，我一掌拍扁它。
lines.en: A beetle crawls by and I flatten it with a palm.

lines.zh: 我把抢来的扣子排成一排。
lines.en: I line up the buttons I stole in a row.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处炊烟，肚子叫了。
lines.en: I stare at distant cook smoke and my stomach growls.

lines.zh: 没人来，我只好对着石头说话。
lines.en: Nobody comes, so I talk to a rock.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，先看你的腰带。
lines.en: I look up at you, at your belt first.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你的口袋。
lines.en: You look at me; I look at your pockets.

lines.zh: 你别笑，我牙虽然黄但有劲。
lines.en: Do not laugh; my teeth are yellow but strong.

lines.zh: 你比我高一头，我记下了。
lines.en: You are a head taller, and I will remember that.

lines.zh: 我眯眼看你的手，看有没有吃的。
lines.en: I squint at your hands, checking for food.

lines.zh: 你把剑放下了？那我就不客气了。
lines.en: You put your sword down? Then I will not hold back.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我就冲你咧嘴。
lines.en: You stare at me, so I grin back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子是新的，走路声音好听。
lines.en: Your boots are new, and they make a fine sound.

lines.zh: 我往你脚边看，地上有面包屑。
lines.en: I look by your feet; there are bread crumbs.

lines.zh: 你看我的样子，像在看一只虫子。
lines.en: You look at me the way one looks at a bug.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肩，我骂了一句。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and I curse.

lines.zh: 这一下让我蹲了下去，牙也磕了。
lines.en: The blow drops me to a crouch and I bite my lip.

lines.zh: 我流了点血，不碍事，别再来。
lines.en: I bleed a little; it is fine, just stop.

lines.zh: 我抱着头往草里钻。
lines.en: I cover my head and burrow into the grass.

lines.zh: 疼得我棍子都握不稳。
lines.en: It hurts so much I can hardly hold my club.

lines.zh: 我边跑边回头，看你还追不追。
lines.en: I run and look back to see if you still follow.

lines.zh: 我鼻子断了，说话有点漏风。
lines.en: My nose is broken, so my words whistle.

lines.zh: 这伤得涂点泥，老办法。
lines.en: This needs mud on it, the old way.

lines.zh: 我咬住牙，不让你听见我哼。
lines.en: I clench my teeth so you will not hear me whimper.

lines.zh: 我知道打不过了，可我不认。
lines.en: I know I cannot win, but I will not admit it.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，够我吃两天。
lines.en: That meat in your hand would feed me two days.

lines.zh: 我闻到面包味，脚就自己动了。
lines.en: I smell bread and my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 把吃的扔过来，我就不追你。
lines.en: Toss the food over and I will not chase you.

lines.zh: 那枚戒指在闪，我眼睛跟着亮。
lines.en: That ring glints and my eyes light up.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西，值几块铁。
lines.en: That thing on your belt is worth some iron.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，声音很大。
lines.en: I swallow, and it is loud.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我往前一步。
lines.en: You step back once and I step forward once.

lines.zh: 我不要命，我要你手上那袋东西。
lines.en: I do not want your life; I want that bag in your hand.

lines.zh: 给我一颗宝石，我告诉你路。
lines.en: Give me one gem and I will tell you the road.

lines.zh: 我的手已经伸出去了，别怪我。
lines.en: My hand is already out, so do not blame me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚，我先叫起来。
lines.en: You step on my foot and I cry out first.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你腿上，弹进草丛。
lines.en: I headbutt your leg and bounce into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你几乎没动。
lines.en: I shove you and you barely move.

lines.zh: 别挤，我背后就是河。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; there is a river behind.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，我摸到你口袋。
lines.en: We bump, and I feel your pocket.

lines.zh: 我摔了个屁股墩，还嘴硬。
lines.en: I land on my backside and still talk tough.

lines.zh: 我一肩膀顶过去，你退了半步。
lines.en: I ram with a shoulder and you give half a step.

lines.zh: 你身上硬，撞得我牙疼。
lines.en: You are hard, and the bump hurts my teeth.

lines.zh: 我趁乱扯了一下你的披风。
lines.en: In the confusion I yank your cloak.

lines.zh: 撞完我滚了一圈，棍子丢了。
lines.en: After the bump I roll once and lose my club.

lines.zh: 另一个跟我挤在洞里，抢被子。
lines.en: Another goblin shares my burrow and steals the blanket.

lines.zh: 我们分赃，总是它多拿一块。
lines.en: We split loot, and it always takes one more piece.

lines.zh: 它比我矮，却比我嗓门大。
lines.en: It is shorter than me but louder.

lines.zh: 天黑后我们轮班，一个睡一个听。
lines.en: After dark we take shifts: one sleeps, one listens.

lines.zh: 它偷了我的扣子，我偷了它的骨头。
lines.en: It stole my button; I stole its bone.

lines.zh: 两只一起走，胆子就大一点。
lines.en: Two of us walking together feel a bit braver.

lines.zh: 我们打架也一起，挨揍也一起。
lines.en: We fight together and get beaten together.

lines.zh: 它一叫，我就知道有东西来了。
lines.en: When it calls, I know something is coming.

lines.zh: 分家那天，我们为一口锅吵了半天。
lines.en: When we split up, we argued half a day over a pot.

lines.zh: 它死了，我把它藏的东西挖出来。
lines.en: It died, so I dug up what it had hidden.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，谁先看见归谁。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the ground belongs to whoever spots it first.

lines.zh: 我捡了根铁钉，觉得发了财。
lines.en: I pick up an iron nail and feel rich.

lines.zh: 这袋子破了，我照样拖走。
lines.en: The sack is torn, but I drag it off anyway.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进怀里，鼓得像肚子。
lines.en: I stuff it into my shirt until I look pregnant.

lines.zh: 捡东西得弯腰，我腰不好。
lines.en: Picking things up means bending, and my back is bad.

lines.zh: 你掉了块煤，我比你先到。
lines.en: You drop a piece of coal and I get there first.

lines.zh: 我捡起破碗，还能盛汤。
lines.en: I pick up a cracked bowl; it can still hold soup.

lines.zh: 这剑太重，我拖着走。
lines.en: This sword is too heavy, so I drag it.

lines.zh: 我把亮的东西藏在鞋里。
lines.en: I hide the shiny things in my shoes.

lines.zh: 捡完我就跑，不等人问。
lines.en: Once I have it, I run before anyone asks.

lines.zh: 你背对着我，这就不怪我了。
lines.en: You have your back to me, so it is not my fault.

lines.zh: 我看见你落单，脚步就快了。
lines.en: I see you alone and my steps quicken.

lines.zh: 你是外来的，外来的都好欺负。
lines.en: You are an outsider, and outsiders are easy.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁和面包，两样都要。
lines.en: I smell iron and bread, and I want both.

lines.zh: 它先看了我一眼，我记仇。
lines.en: It glanced at me, and I hold grudges.

lines.zh: 有东西在我洞口转，我拿棍子。
lines.en: Something circles my burrow, so I take my club.

lines.zh: 你走得太慢，我等着你走近。
lines.en: You walk too slowly, so I wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 我数你几个人，一个，好办。
lines.en: I count your group: one. Easy.

lines.zh: 它踩了我的地盘，草都算我的。
lines.en: It stepped on my turf; even the grass is mine.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从石头后面出来。
lines.en: I crouch low and come out from behind the rock.

lines.zh: 你手里没火把，天黑得正好。
lines.en: No torch in your hand, and dark falls just right.

lines.zh: 同伴吹了声口哨，我知道该上了。
lines.en: My partner whistles, and I know it is time.

lines.zh: 它把后背给我，我笑了一声。
lines.en: It turns its back to me and I laugh once.

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在抖，我先动了。
lines.en: I see your hand shake, so I move first.

lines.zh: 我看到你的包裹，比看到你高兴。
lines.en: I am happier to see your pack than you.

lines.zh: 你踩响树枝，我抓着棍子出来。
lines.en: You snap a branch, and I come out with my club.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，找你的破绽。
lines.en: I circle you, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 我贴着地皮靠近，不直冲。
lines.en: I creep low instead of charging straight.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就等你放下。
lines.en: You raise your shield, so I wait for it to drop.

lines.zh: 我用棍子敲地，让你以为我在左。
lines.en: I tap the ground with my club to fake left.

lines.zh: 我故意露出破口，等你来追。
lines.en: I show a gap on purpose, waiting for you to chase.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，那儿更好办。
lines.en: You back to a wall, which suits me better.

lines.zh: 我蹲低，像一只大青蛙。
lines.en: I crouch low like a big frog.

lines.zh: 我在等你眨眼，人眨眼会松手。
lines.en: I wait for you to blink; hands loosen then.

lines.zh: 我踢起一把土，往你脸上扬。
lines.en: I kick up dirt and throw it at your face.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我抢先堵住路口。
lines.en: It tries to run, so I block the path first.

lines.zh: 我数到三就扑，这次数到二。
lines.en: I count to three before lunging; this time I count to two.

lines.zh: 我的棍子拖在身后，随时能抬。
lines.en: My club drags behind me, ready to lift.

lines.zh: 你往右看，我已经绕到左边。
lines.en: You look right, and I am already on the left.

lines.zh: 我朝同伴喊了一声，合围。
lines.en: I shout to my partner and we close in.

lines.zh: 你往后躲，我绕到你右边。
lines.en: You dodge back; I swing around your right.

lines.zh: 我踢石头，看你能不能站住。
lines.en: I kick a stone to see if you keep your feet.

lines.zh: 我躲在树后，等你背对我。
lines.en: I hide behind a tree, waiting for your back.

lines.zh: 我喊一声，另一头也有人应。
lines.en: I shout, and another answers from the far side.

lines.zh: 你举剑太正，我偏着打。
lines.en: You hold your sword too square; I strike from an angle.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼，等你踩错脚。
lines.en: I close in step by step, waiting for a wrong foot.

lines.zh: 我照小腿打，那地方最疼。
lines.en: I swing at the shins, where it hurts most.

lines.zh: 这一棍下去，你的护腿响了。
lines.en: The club lands and your legging rings.

lines.zh: 我打完就退，不给你抓我。
lines.en: I hit and retreat before you can grab me.

lines.zh: 我跳起来敲你的手，抢你的剑。
lines.en: I jump to smack your hand and take your sword.

lines.zh: 这地方是我的，滚出去。
lines.en: This place is mine, so get out.

lines.zh: 我叫着扑上去，声音比力气大。
lines.en: I lunge screaming, louder than my strength.

lines.zh: 棍子断了，我就用牙。
lines.en: My club breaks, so I use my teeth.

lines.zh: 我打你的膝盖，你就矮了。
lines.en: I strike your knee, and down you go.

lines.zh: 这一下没打中，我摔在泥里。
lines.en: The swing misses and I land in the mud.

lines.zh: 我踢你的盾，脚趾全麻了。
lines.en: I kick your shield and my toes go numb.

lines.zh: 我从背后打，最省力。
lines.en: I hit from behind; it takes the least effort.

lines.zh: 你血溅到我脸上，我舔了一口。
lines.en: Your blood spatters my face, and I lick it.

lines.zh: 它倒下了，我先翻它的袋子。
lines.en: It falls, and I search its bag first.

lines.zh: 我抡圆了棍子，肩膀差点脱力。
lines.en: I swing my club wide and nearly wrench my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抡棍砸你握剑的手。
lines.en: I swing my club at your sword hand.

lines.zh: 这一棍打偏，砸在树根上。
lines.en: The club goes wide and bites a root.

lines.zh: 我跳起来咬你的耳朵。
lines.en: I leap up and bite your ear.

lines.zh: 你把我踹开，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: You kick me off and I roll twice.

lines.zh: 我拿石头扔你，趁你低头。
lines.en: I throw a stone and rush while you duck.

lines.zh: 抢到东西我就跑，别追。
lines.en: Once I have the loot I run; do not follow.

lines.zh: 我从草里钻出来，头顶全是叶子。
lines.en: I crawl out of the grass with leaves on my head.

lines.zh: 生成时身边还有一只，它先跑了。
lines.en: Another spawns beside me and bolts first.

lines.zh: 我落在山道上，风把我吹醒。
lines.en: I land on a mountain path, and wind wakes me.

lines.zh: 睁眼就是平原，好多东西可以拿。
lines.en: I open my eyes to plains full of things to take.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼肚子就空了，向来如此。
lines.en: My belly is empty the moment I open my eyes, as always.

lines.zh: 林子太密，我找了半天出口。
lines.en: The woods are dense; I hunt for the way out.

lines.zh: 我先摸了摸口袋，什么都没有。
lines.en: I check my pocket first: nothing.

lines.zh: 阳光太亮，我躲到树根下面。
lines.en: Sunlight is too bright, so I hide under roots.

lines.zh: 附近有村落，我闻到了烟。
lines.en: A village is near; I smell smoke.

lines.zh: 我第一次握棍子，握反了。
lines.en: The first time I hold a club, I hold it backward.

lines.zh: 我想叫一声壮胆，叫得很难听。
lines.en: I try a shout for courage, and it sounds awful.

lines.zh: 我挑了个背风的坡，先蹲下看看。
lines.en: I pick a sheltered slope and squat to look around.

lines.zh: 火一沾毛，臭得我自己都皱眉。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and the stink makes even me frown.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，石子硌得慌。
lines.en: Rolling down the slope, the stones jab hard.

lines.zh: 水直往鼻子里灌，我乱抓。
lines.en: Water pours up my nose and I claw wildly.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响，什么也听不见。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing and I hear nothing.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，像根多出来的骨头。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like an extra bone.

lines.zh: 那光一绕，我的腿就不听话了。
lines.en: That light coils and my legs stop obeying.

lines.zh: 饿到第三天，我看石头都像面包。
lines.en: By the third day hungry, stones look like bread.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我旁边，我吓得趴下了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and I flatten in fear.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的口袋还在身上。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my pocket is still with me.
